summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary  I traced the full path read-only (no edits made): `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite schema, plus the auth layer (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `hooks/useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx` routing).  **What's already correct, contrary to the ticket's suspicion:** - No localStorage/sessionStorage fallback anywhere in the watchlist flow (only the unrelated theme toggle uses localStorage). - Every watchlist route (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE`) checks `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` — no anonymous/default/guest watchli
